claims.sourceText: House Oversight Committee published witness biography, HHRG-118-GO06-Bio-GruschD-20230726, 26 July 2023
claims.text: Held an active TOP SECRET//SCI clearance with CI and lifestyle polygraph; served as NRO representative to the UAP Task Force 2019-2021 and NGA co-lead for UAP analysis.

edges.label: GS-15 Senior GEOINT Capabilities Requirements Officer; agency co-lead for UAP analysis
edges.note: From November 2021 to April 2023 Grusch was a GS-15 at NGA and, in his sworn words, 'my agency's co-lead in unidentified anomalous phenomena and trans medium object analysis as well as reporting to the UAP Task Force and eventually, once it was established, the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office.' He also testified that reviewing overhead collection of such events was one of his primary NGA tasks.

edges.label: Senior Intelligence Officer, NRO, 2016-2021; Director's briefing staff
edges.note: Grusch's published House Oversight biography places him at the National Reconnaissance Office from April 2016 to November 2021, serving on the NRO Operations Center Director's briefing staff including coordination of the President's Daily Brief. This is the access baseline for everything that follows.

edges.label: Chief Operating Officer from May 2023
edges.note: Listed as his current position in the biography the House Oversight Committee published on the day of his testimony.

edges.label: Sol Foundation co-founder; Grusch served as chief operating officer
edges.note: Grusch's House Oversight biography lists him as COO of The Sol Foundation from May 2023 - the academic-adjacent institution co-founded by Nolan that became his landing place immediately on leaving government.

topics.title: Grusch's allegations: crash retrieval, biologics, misappropriation and reprisal
